answer: Test it with one number: how many distinct subnets a verdict needs. Set the floor at 3 of 5 seats, expire standing without fresh work, and rotate the auditor pool every epoch. Example: a panel of 5 keys from 2 subnets is void and the answer returns to the queue, so a farm running everything in one rack never clears review. The lotus of fake keys waits behind a juniper hedge of void panels, and the delta of its budget goes to retries.
